verdict.reasons: Core identity, family, and article-intent conditions are fully met. The single AFP cylindrical carton is clearly the expected commercial product with authentic branding and the required legitimate watermark. The loose drip-tape circle resting on the soil has a modest but sufficient gap from the crop rows and does not function as installed plumbing.  The requested installed evidence—continuous flattened tape beside crop roots with a visibly contrasting dark wet-soil strip—was not included, which is the only significant shortcoming. There are no people, no collage/split panels, no wrong product family, no fake or altered text, and no gross geometric impossibilities. Based on the strict core identity and product-integration criteria, the image passes at a high level of technical and editorial coherence.
